products.shortDescription: 800gm. A bread with 100% rye is a whole-grain bread.
products.description: It’s much healthier than your typical wheat bread. It has fewer carbohydrates, more fibres , and generally fills your stomach nicely (per calorie eaten). The bread has a soft crust, a dense but soft crumb, a nice chew, and a slight crunch from the moist seeds.
products.ingredients: Organic rye flour, organic broken and whole rye grains, flax seeds,, sunflower seeds, malt, water, sourdough, sea salt. Sprinkled with rough rolled rye flakes on top.

reviews.author: Mandy Thomas
reviews.text: My Granny Svea was Swedish, arriving at her country gate as a child, was to be filled with the aroma of fruit buns in the oven, that had been loving prepared in the very early hours of the morning .. just for us. This little shop has that same heart in is beautiful breads and delivered with such warm friendly service. Every morsel .. pure magic.

reviews.author: Ian Cooper
reviews.text: This bakery is absolutely amazing! Sourdough unlike any other, their products are so delicious, to die for!! The baker and his staff are such lovely people, don't pass this one if in the area, absolute 10 out of 10 xxx thank you Simply Sourdough.

reviews.author: Grace Cameron
reviews.text: Really flavourful bread and pastry. All three things we've tried so far have been special (cinnamon bun, cardamom and custard doughnut and rye and pumpkin seed sourdough bread). A little hole in the wall in a little alley. I'm so glad we followed our nose when we smelled that delicious smell walking past.

reviews.author: Violet Renner-Davis
reviews.text: wow! just wow! we too smelt the cinnamon rolls from the footpath and was drawn down the alleyway to this cute little shop. we were served a cinnamon scroll right from the oven and it was so tasty and warm! i definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Gem Star
reviews.text: OMG the cinnamon scroll with a hint of cardamom was divine! I followed the scent of fresh bread into the arcade, and was lucky enough to get freshly baked warm cinnamon scroll. Soft bun, perfectly sweet, spiced and warm.. Soo good.

reviews.author: Dani T
reviews.text: I was only walking past when the familiar sent caught me off guard the aroma of the cinnamon rolls from my childhood my grandmother would make who comes from Finland, I can say these cinnamon rolls are some of the best and give any Nordic grandma a run for their money! I can't wait for my next trip back :)

reviews.author: Gustaf Brithén
reviews.text: A tiny little bakery you'll only find if you smell your way there. High quality and organic. Traditional handmade Scandinavian products.

settings.tagline: Artisan sourdough and Swedish buns, baked fresh in Lismore
settings.hours: Tue–Fri 8:00 AM–5:00 PM · Sat 7:00 AM–2:00 PM · or until sold out
settings.aboutStory: Farid’s passion for sourdough ignited in his childhood, watching his mother create magic in the kitchen. Over 14 years he honed his craft as a baker in Denmark and Sweden. Four years ago he moved to Lismore and founded Simply Sourdough — a micro-bakery celebrating traditional Nordic recipes with only fresh, natural ingredients and slow fermentation.
